sense: to look at something for a time, like a film

pins.definition: To look at something for a period of time, especially a film or show.
To view something attentively over a period of time, such as a film, show, or match.
To look at something attentively over a period of time, or to go and see an attraction.

situation: A woman sitting alone in a dark living room is illuminated entirely by the flickering blue glow of a large television screen.
subject: attentive viewing
brief: A woman sits in a dark apartment with her face lit by the cold, rhythmic glow of a large television screen, staring fixedly at the moving images. The room behind her is in deep shadow, and her wide eyes reflect the bright, changing colors of the film playing in the dark.
prompt: A woman sits in a dark apartment with her face lit by the cold, rhythmic glow of a large television screen, staring fixedly at the moving images. The room behind her is in deep shadow, and her wide eyes reflect the bright, changing colors of the film playing in the dark. a rain-slick neon night street, teal and magenta signage bleeding into volumetric haze, wet reflections, high dynamic range. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
